LESSON: KUSOMA 9.2.1 KUSOMA KWA MAPANA MATINI YA KUJICHAGULIA

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: MAGONJWA Mada Mada Ndogo Matokeo Maalum Yanayotarajiwa Shughuli za Ujifunzaji Zi
Topic 9.2: Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo ni somo la kusoma: Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia. Soma maelezo, fuata mifano iliyofanyiwa kazi, kisha fanya mazoezi.

SEHEMU 2: MALENGO

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. explain Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia in simple words
2. give Kenyan school/community examples of Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia
3. describe one responsible action linked to Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia
4. show respect and fairness when practising Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia

SEHEMU 3: SOMO (MAELEZO NA MIFANO)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: KUSOMA 9.2.1 KUSOMA KWA MAPANA MATINI YA KUJICHAGULIA
Subject: KISWAHILI · Grade: Grade 5
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia helps you succeed in KISWAHILI. You will understand it, practise it, and use it nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

KEY FACTS: KUSOMA 9.2.1 KUSOMA KWA MAPANA MATINI YA KUJICHAGULIA
Good citizens follow rules, respect others, and care for shared places.
Kenyan examples: lining up, keeping the compound clean, telling the truth, helping a classmate.
Rights come with responsibilities.

PART 1: Explain Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia in simple words

What this means
In this part you learn to explain Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia in simple words. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia in simple words.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kusoma: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia in simple words. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Give Kenyan school/community examples of Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia

What this means
In this part you learn to give Kenyan school/community examples of Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: give Kenyan school/community examples of Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kuzungumza: Zungumza na rafiki kwa dakika 1 kuhusu Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can give Kenyan school/community examples of Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Describe one responsible action linked to Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia

What this means
In this part you learn to describe one responsible action linked to Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe one responsible action linked to Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kuandika: Andika sentensi 3 sahihi kuhusu Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe one responsible action linked to Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Show respect and fairness when practising Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia

What this means
In this part you learn to show respect and fairness when practising Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: show respect and fairness when practising Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kusoma: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can show respect and fairness when practising Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO YA HARAKA

Good citizens follow rules, respect others, and care for shared places.

Kenyan examples: lining up, keeping the compound clean, telling the truth, helping a classmate.

Example 1: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako. (skill: explain Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia in simple words)

Example 2: Zungumza na rafiki kwa dakika 1 kuhusu Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia. (skill: give Kenyan school/community examples of Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia)

Example 3: Andika sentensi 3 sahihi kuhusu Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia. (skill: describe one responsible action linked to Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia)

Example 4: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako. (skill: show respect and fairness when practising Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia)

SEHEMU 5: MAZOEZI

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia in simple words.
3. Practise this skill: give Kenyan school/community examples of Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia.
4. Practise this skill: describe one responsible action linked to Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA NYUMBANI

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 5 learner study Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. Know what Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia in simple words.
5. Be able to: give Kenyan school/community examples of Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia.

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
